title: Cosmo Magnat
description:
Enter the world of Cosmic Megapolis, an exciting 3D construction genre game where you will become the architect of your own city in space! 

Your task is to create a thriving city on an uncharted planet using advanced technologies and innovative building materials. 



Game features: 

 3D Building 

 Coin Collection 

 Economy Management
